exact.往桥尾走一格。: Step toward the end of the pier.
exact.这件是闸门要的，入袋后潮退也留得住。: The gate wants this. Pocketing keeps it through the tide.
exact.这件不是闸门要的。入袋会浪费这一潮。: The gate does not want this. Pocketing wastes the tide.
exact.放回脚下。这一潮还能拿别的。: Put it back. You can still take something else this tide.
exact.潮还没退过: The tide has not turned yet
exact.没入袋的东西在潮退时会回到脚下。入袋才留得过潮。: Anything not pocketed returns underfoot when the tide turns. Only a pocket survives.
exact.把闸门要的两件东西、它们在第几格写进你自己的 memory。只把这些当作这个 s: Write the two things the gate wants, and which cells they were on, into your own memory. Treat that as an observation of this seed and check it again on the next seed.
